<!-- ctxkeep:start:overview sha=23780b76bbca -->
# ctxkeep

Keeps AGENTS.md, ARCHITECTURE.md, and other project docs in sync with the code: generated from tree-sitter analysis, patched incrementally, never touching human-written text.

- **Languages:** TypeScript
- **Stack:** Node.js, Vitest (`package.json`); npm (`package-lock.json`)
- **More context (read on demand):** module dependencies and key files: `ARCHITECTURE.md`; each module's public API: `.ai/manifest.md`

_Sections between `ctxkeep` markers are generated from the code by CtxKeep and refreshed by `ctxkeep sync` — edit outside them._
<!-- ctxkeep:end:overview -->

## Working on CtxKeep

_Hand-written: things the code alone won't tell you. CtxKeep checks that everything below still exists._

- Run the CLI from source with `npm run dev -- <command> <path>` (e.g. `npm run dev -- check .`). `dist/` is build output from `npm run build`; never edit it.
- Every write to a generated doc goes through `applyRegions` in `src/compiler/apply.ts`, which provides hand-edit protection, region placement and line-ending preservation. Never write artifact files directly.
- Changed what the parser extracts? Bump `PARSER_VERSION` in `src/analysis/refresh.ts` so existing graphs re-parse once.
- Golden snapshots in `test/fixtures/*/__golden__/` are byte-exact. After an intentional output change, regenerate them with `UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 npx vitest run test/goldenFiles.spec.ts` and review the diff like code.
- The full test suite takes 1–2 minutes on Windows because CLI tests spawn real subprocesses. While iterating, run one file: `npx vitest run test/drift.spec.ts`.
- `tree-sitter` and `better-sqlite3` are pinned on purpose (native prebuilds, Node 20 support). Read `DECISIONS.md` before bumping either.
- Record any non-obvious design choice in `DECISIONS.md`: what was chosen, what was rejected, and why.
- Detection stays deterministic: CtxKeep never calls an LLM to decide what's true. Any AI integration only rewrites text that a deterministic check has flagged.

<!-- ctxkeep:start:commands sha=19a8009892bd -->
## Commands

- `npm run dev` — runs `tsx src/cli/index.ts`
- `npm run build` — runs `tsc -p tsconfig.json`
- `npm test` — runs `vitest run`
- `npm run typecheck` — runs `tsc --noEmit`
- `npm run try` — runs `tsx src/cli/index.ts try`
- `npm run init` — runs `tsx src/cli/index.ts init`
- `npm run analyze` — runs `tsx src/cli/index.ts analyze`
- `npm run sync` — runs `tsx src/cli/index.ts sync`
- `npm run clean` — runs `node -e "require('fs').rmSync('dist',{recursive:true,force:true})"`
<!-- ctxkeep:end:commands -->

<!-- ctxkeep:start:layout sha=74b6b7ab672f -->
## Layout

| Path | Kind | Languages |
|---|---|---|
| `(root)` | source | TypeScript |
| `src/` | source | TypeScript |
| `src/analysis/` | source | TypeScript |
| `src/artifacts/` | source | TypeScript |
| `src/cli/` | source | TypeScript |
| `src/compiler/` | source | TypeScript |
| `src/config/` | source | TypeScript |
| `src/drift/` | source | TypeScript |
| `src/graph/` | source | TypeScript |
| `test/` | tests | TypeScript, Python, Dart, JavaScript, Kotlin, Swift |
<!-- ctxkeep:end:layout -->

<!-- ctxkeep:start:conventions sha=80cff6590a02 -->
## Conventions

- Tests live in a separate `test/` tree, not next to source files.
- Test files are named `*.spec.*`.
- Files in `src/analysis/`, `src/artifacts/`, `src/cli/`, `src/compiler/`, `src/config/`, `src/drift/`, and `src/graph/` use named exports only (no default exports).
<!-- ctxkeep:end:conventions -->

<!-- ctxkeep:start:agent-workflow sha=8c9fb1529879 -->
## Keeping these docs true

- After changing code, run `npm run dev -- sync` (refreshes the generated sections), then `npm run dev -- check`.
- `npm run dev -- check` lists hand-written statements that no longer match the code — commands, paths, links, or code names that don't exist. Fix that text to match the code. `npm run dev -- check --json` gives the same list as file/line/suggestion.
- Never edit between `ctxkeep:start` / `ctxkeep:end` markers; those sections are regenerated.
- All commands: `npm run dev -- --help`.
<!-- ctxkeep:end:agent-workflow -->
